title: FoodHouseholdChatContext
description: food.household-chat-context@1: what food.household.read answers (GET /internal/households/:planId/chat-context): a household's pantry and plan as plain text for the AI member of its OpenVibe.Chat room, and where it comes from.

text.description: The household's members, the plan (days, people, budget, meals), what is still to buy and what is in their cupboards.

source.description: A label for the prompt, e.g. 'OpenVibe.Food household'.
